sentences.text: The documents do not state any RBI monetary penalty for a UCB that levies prohibited foreclosure charges.

They state that, for loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges in the cases covered by paragraph 261(1), paragraph 261(2)(ii), paragraph 261(6), and where pre-payment is effected at the instance of the bank.
They also state that the applicability or otherwise of pre-payment charges shall be clearly disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and in the KFS where KFS is to be provided.
No pre-payment charges which have not been disclosed as specified herein shall be charged by a UCB.

missing.slot: RBI monetary penalty for a UCB that levies prohibited foreclosure charges
